comparisonTiming.scope: 297 cards, inspect and table PNGs, metrics, alignment diagnostics and preview encoding in Node. Warm run verifies image checksums. Excludes download and browser capture; not a GPU benchmark.

paired.note: Identical inputs, reference bytes, metrics, browser and alignment only. Body deltas require reviewed wording and confident alignment. ±0.02 is a review flag, not a validated acceptance threshold.

assetReview.caveat: Color is not scored. Frame geometry, scan alignment, and co-occurring components can contribute; inspect examples before replacing assets.

limitations: 273 body texts use unreviewed Oracle wording; all-card body scores are diagnostic.
20 alignment flags include four uncalibrated large-planeswalker frames; no per-scan correction is applied.
Only ordinary-face text has measured overflow checks (283 cards).
Artwork, crown details, paper textures and security stamps are not independently scored.
Regressions are review flags; edge F1 alone is not a perceptual correctness percentage.
